irregularities.title: Roster index pruned 19 record(s) no current source supports
irregularities.detail: The player index is pruned each run: a (club, player) record is dropped when the official report names the player under a different club and no current source still asserts it, or when no source has asserted it for 14 days. Dropped this run: NE:ben-brown (not asserted by any source for 14.0 days); CHI:grady-jarrett (official report lists the player under a different club); HOU:will-anderson (official report lists the player under a different club); HOU:kayden-mcdonald (official report lists the player under a different club); CIN:jonathan-allen (official report lists the player under a different club); BAL:ja-kobi-lane (not asserted by any source for 14.0 days); CHI:shemar-turner (official report lists the player under a different club); IND:charvarius-ward (official report lists the player under a different club); SEA:beau-stephens (not asserted by any source for 14.0 days); MIA:kyle-louis (not asserted by any source for 14.0 days); BAL:kyle-hamilton (official report lists the player under a different club); NE:carlton-davis (official report lists the player under a different club); MIN:brian-o-neill (official report lists the player under a different club); HOU:mj-stewart (official report lists the player under a different club); NE:brenden-schooler (official report lists the player under a different club); CHI:noah-sewell (official report lists the player under a different club); BAL:calais-campbell (official report lists the player under a different club); HOU:jamal-hill (official report lists the player under a different club); DET:tyleik-williams (official report lists the player under a different club). This is the guard against stale records mis-attributing in-game events (see the 2026-09-16 HOU/GB misattribution in the README verification log).

irregularities.title: 15 reporter claim(s) contradicted by the official report
irregularities.detail: These claims are retained (not deleted) because a contradicted claim is the evidence that drives a reporter's score down. Examples: rapsheet.bsky.social said ACTIVE for Monroe Freeling (official: see link); rapsheet.bsky.social said QUESTIONABLE for Tyjae Spears (official: see link); tompelissero.bsky.social said OUT for Jayden Daniels (official: see link); tompelissero.bsky.social said ACTIVE for Ladd McConkey (official: see link); Jon Machota said IR for Tyler Smith (official: see link)

irregularities.title: Beat writer Aaron Wilson is attributed across 2 clubs (HOU, JAX)
irregularities.detail: ESPN printed Aaron Wilson (KPRC 2 Houston) as the attribution on updates for multiple clubs. Local beat writers normally cover one club, so this is usually a shared-wire/aggregator attribution; it is kept as observed and flagged for manual review rather than reassigned by guesswork.

irregularities.title: Longest gap between collector runs is 3575 minutes
irregularities.detail: The workflow is scheduled every 5 minutes, but GitHub throttles and queues scheduled workflows, so this is the cadence the collector actually achieved over the archived runs. Alerts can only be as timely as this number: see the cadence panel on the site, which is fed from the same measurement.
